title: A Live Plotter: The Data Rate Is Not the Frame Rate
fallback: Lesson 10-02 builds the same chart with the same arithmetic and prints it to a terminal, needing nothing installed. What this lesson adds is the widget and the separation between the rate data arrives at and the rate a screen is redrawn at. Without Qt, do 10-02: it is the half that decides whether a chart tells the truth.
